name: GlowingButton
purpose: The site's only real call-to-action control: a pill with a conic-gradient border chase, a travelling sparkle layer and a hover bloom.
structure: `<span class=effect aria-hidden>` + `<span class=text>`; ::before is the sparkle, ::after the hover bloom, .effect::before/::after the ring.

motion.sparkle: line-anim var(--duration) infinite, sky-anim 2s var(--easing) infinite

copyBudget.note: Longest real label is 39 characters / 6 words.
